hypothesis_tested: Atlas compares revisions but its semantic entities do not keep a stable identity across source edits
blocking_question_recorded: no SymbolOccurrence consumer / occurrence import not scheduled (a sequencing block)
blocking_question_status: superseded: the hypothesis was falsifiable by measurement without any occurrence import

phase_1_current_atlas.identity_construction: FunctionIdentity::identity_key = repository|revision|language|scope|symbol|span.path:line:column|...; SymbolIdentity key has no span but its scope carries no module path; self-recensus diffs per file
phase_1_current_atlas.method: cases applied to real Atlas source (core/src/language/adl/census.rs, 62 functions in the two subject files), release systemize, FUNCTION_IDENTITY record ids compared, tree restored

A2 body edit, +1 line early in file.failure: 5 unchanged functions lost identity (line shift); the edited one invisible

D move within file.failure: moved and one shifted function lost identity

E move to another module.failure: delete + create, plus one spurious loss

phase_1_current_atlas.across_commits: all 1,811 function record ids change on every commit (revision in the key); the per-artifact extraction cache is keyed by revision and never reuses a batch across a commit
phase_1_current_atlas.span_free_collisions: removing the span from the function key collides 39 keys across 103 files (main, root, snapshot, same-named test helpers); SymbolIdentity definition keys collide 49 times across files -- a module path is required
downstream_cost: self-recensus is file-granular: an unintended change to another function inside a declared path is accepted silently
graph/provenance continuity: no cross-revision entity relation exists (every record id is revision-bound)

scip_mechanisms_censused.symbol_identity: scip.proto L150-188: <scheme> <manager> <package> <version> <descriptor>+; descriptors namespace '/', type '#', term '.', method '(<disambiguator>).', local symbols document-scoped; no position and no file path in identity
scip_mechanisms_censused.occurrences: scip.proto L692+: ranges and a SymbolRole bitset (L524-546) live on occurrences, never in identity
scip_mechanisms_censused.documents: Document.relative_path owns occurrences and defined symbols (L76-121)
scip_mechanisms_censused.package_identity: Package{manager,name,version} is part of every global symbol: SCIP symbols are version-specific by design
scip_mechanisms_censused.revision_behavior: none: DESIGN.md lists code-modification use cases as a non-goal; file-level incrementality is an indexer property, not cross-revision correspondence
scip_mechanisms_censused.collision_assumption: descriptors must form a fully qualified name unique across the package; overloads use the method disambiguator

decision.ABSORBED: position-free, revision-free descriptor identity (package + module namespaces + lexical scope + name + method suffix, SCIP escaping) with positions kept out of identity -- native in core::recensus::entity, no SCIP code or dependency
decision.ATLAS_NATIVE_NOT_FROM_SCIP: cross-revision correspondence (SAME/CHANGED/RENAMED/MOVED/MOVED_RENAMED/DELETED/CREATED/AMBIGUOUS) from equal descriptors or equal (signature, body) token fingerprints; ties and duplicated descriptors AMBIGUOUS, never forced
REFERENCE_ONLY: occurrence role bitset and typed position encoding (no occurrence consumer)
the protobuf exchange format and version-in-identity (Atlas identity must be revision-free)
method disambiguator ordinals (order-dependent; Atlas reports duplicates as AMBIGUOUS instead)

phase_2_atlas_n_plus_1.method: same cases through atlas-systemizer recensus prove against a v3 baseline, intent declaring only the edited paths

E move to another module.evidence: identical signature and body; visibility inherited -> pub(crate)

H delete + recreate under new name elsew.evidence: identical signature and body; visibility inherited -> pub(crate)

additional.K collateral: intended CHANGED entity_name declared; the undeclared CHANGED derive_census_adl is an unexpected change -> GENERATION_NOT_PROVEN (path-level intent accepted it before)

known_limits: local-variable rename reports CHANGED body (token-exact, no alpha-equivalence)
module inference follows Cargo layout; #[path] is not seen
functions/methods only; types/traits/constants not yet in the entity layer
.atlas container unchanged: the entity layer is a self-recensus projection, not packaged canonical state

extinction.references: documentation/provenance only (pinned commit, license, provenance kept)

p4_update: descriptor identity is the prerequisite for cross-commit reuse: extraction batches embed the revision, so today no batch survives a commit; entity-keyed reuse would also let invalidation follow changed entities rather than changed files
